tap.thingExpr: (() => { const g = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'zone:bridge-gap').zone; const ps = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.filter((e) => e.item && g.items.includes(e.id)); const rest = g.gap - ps.reduce((a, e) => a + e.item.size, 0); const pile = tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'zone:bridge-pile').zone.items.map((id) => tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === id)).filter(Boolean); const can = (r, list) => r === 0 || list.some((e, k) => e.item.size <= r && can(r - e.item.size, list.slice(k + 1))); const ok = pile.filter((e, k) => e.item.size <= rest && can(rest - e.item.size, pile.filter((x) => x !== e))).sort((a, b) => b.item.size - a.item.size); return ok[0]?.id ?? null; })()
